":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":13,"text":"房间中的低沉言语再次响起，将苏天晴的注意力拽回眼前这本黑色古书。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":14,"text":"苏天晴有些茫然。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":16,"text":"看着在身侧摇曳的炸毛大尾巴，苏天晴鬼使神差地伸手，在尾巴上用力薅了一把。"}],"coverage":{"through":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":30},"chapters":[1],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视角专属的语义缺口说明。"],"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false},"completeness":{"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false,"matchingRecords":3,"returned":3},"truncation":{"page":false,"depth":false,"unavailableReferences":0},"nextCursor":null},{"schema":"neurobook.memory.query.v1","ok":true,"command":"source","snapshot":{"id":"llm-through-1","sourceManifest":"manifest:0cb898d0b1701fc4","knowledgeRevision":1,"readAt":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":76},"contentHash":"7363ae7d6240cee087f3a9a611bec00da58b0cb95fd613d0eab4f0495b10a77e"},"scope":{"readAt":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":30},"perspective":"reader","world":"original"},"items":[{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":23,"text":"苏天晴干咳两声掩饰尴尬，伸手阻止了面前这本奇怪的古书继续说话，眼珠一转，飞快地理清思绪。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":27,"text":"“你是谁？”苏天晴扭头正视眼前这本书，茫然地说道。"},{"type":"source","sourceId":"source-c01","revision":1,"chapter":1,"paragraph":30,"text":"【而那个人就是你，苏天晴小姐。】"}],"coverage":{"through":{"chapter":1,"paragraph":30},"chapters":[1],"material":"complete","semantic":"partial","gaps":["未提供当前阅读范围与视角专属的语义缺口说明。"],"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false},"completeness":{"recordsExhausted":true,"corpusClosed":false,"matchingRecords":3,"returned":3},"truncation":{"page":false,"depth":false,"unavailableReferences":0},"nextCursor":null}]}]}
